close_reason: PR #68: lefthook pre-commit jobs route through scripts/mise-exec.sh into hook:*-staged mise adapters; staged-only formatting + stage_fixed verified, exclusions respected, minimal-shell commit works, React Doctor advisory with distinct mise-missing hint. rust:test blocked by full disk (os error 28, APFS snapshots pin freed blocks); rust:clippy --all-targets green.
description:
## Background

The pre-commit hook currently runs React Doctor directly, invokes `pnpm dlx ultracite fix`, and invokes `cargo fmt` directly. This permits toolchain drift and leaves the actual quality command definitions outside the canonical mise task graph. React Doctor is intentionally advisory, while formatting jobs are blocking and re-stage fixed files.

The official Ultracite Lefthook integration uses `stage_fixed: true`; Lefthook also supports `{staged_files}` and filters it using `glob` and `exclude`. Beadsmith’s intended contract is strict staged-only formatting, so the implementation must pass staged paths to the mise hook adapter tasks.

## What to build

Rewrite `lefthook.yml` so every pre-commit tool execution goes through `scripts/mise-exec.sh` and the hook adapter tasks in `mise.toml`, while preserving the current three-job structure and behavior.

## Technical Approach

- Keep the React Doctor wrapper that captures output, prints a hint, swallows failures, and never blocks a commit.
- Invoke its adapter with `--staged --blocking warning`.
- Invoke the Ultracite adapter with `{staged_files}` and the existing JavaScript/TypeScript/JSON/CSS glob and exclusions.
- Invoke the Rust formatting adapter with `{staged_files}` and the existing Rust glob/exclusion.
- Keep `stage_fixed: true` for the two formatting jobs.
- Do not put raw `ultracite`, `react-doctor`, or `cargo fmt` gate definitions back into Lefthook.

Expected shape:

```yaml
- run: ./scripts/mise-exec.sh run hook:ultracite-fix -- {staged_files}
  stage_fixed: true

- run: ./scripts/mise-exec.sh run hook:rust-fmt -- {staged_files}
  stage_fixed: true
```

If the staged-only behavior proves incompatible with Ultracite, retain the official repo-wide integration only after documenting that it may modify unstaged files and revising the acceptance contract.

## Considerations

- The generic launcher must work when mise is installed at `$HOME/.local/bin/mise` but that directory is absent from `PATH`.
- Do not silently fall back to system Node, pnpm, or Cargo.
- Exclusions remain consistent with `quality.ignores.ts`; Lefthook keeps them only as trigger filters.
- Test filenames with spaces and mixed staged file types.
- React Doctor’s advisory behavior must remain unchanged even when mise reports a failure.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `lefthook.yml` contains no `pnpm dlx`, `npx react-doctor@latest`, or direct raw quality-tool invocations.
- [ ] React Doctor remains advisory and uses staged scope with warning blocking semantics.
- [ ] Ultracite and Rust formatting receive only matching staged files.
- [ ] `stage_fixed: true` remains enabled for both formatting jobs.
- [ ] Vendored and generated exclusions are respected.
- [ ] A staged TypeScript/CSS/JSON change and a staged Rust change are formatted and re-staged through the mise adapters.
- [ ] An unstaged malformed file is not modified by a staged-only hook run.

## Test Plan

- Run `lefthook run pre-commit` manually with representative staged files.
- Verify `lefthook dump` shows the expected commands and templates.
- Test paths containing spaces.
- Test excluded paths under `docs/research/infra/**` and `.agents/skills/**`.
- Run a commit from a minimal shell after explicit `mise trust` and `mise install`.
- Confirm React Doctor findings are reported but do not fail the commit.

## Triage

ready-for-agent

comments.text:
## Implementation plan

Adapter names match the existing mise.toml hook adapters (bsm-9n1.3): `hook:ultracite-staged`, `hook:react-doctor-staged`, `hook:rust-fmt-staged`. All three already accept raw_args, so passing `{staged_files}` through `-- {staged_files}` just works.

1. Rewrite `lefthook.yml` so every pre-commit tool execution routes through `scripts/mise-exec.sh` and a mise adapter task — no raw `pnpm dlx`, `npx react-doctor`, or `cargo fmt` invocations.
2. React Doctor: keep the capture-and-swallow-failure wrapper, route it through `./scripts/mise-exec.sh run hook:react-doctor-staged`. Do NOT pass `{staged_files}` — the adapter reads the git index itself and would treat appended paths as directory arguments (per the mise.toml comment).
3. Ultracite: `./scripts/mise-exec.sh run hook:ultracite-staged -- {staged_files}` with the existing JS/TS/JSON/JSONC/CSS glob and `docs/research/infra/**` + `.agents/skills/**` exclusions, `stage_fixed: true`.
4. Rust: `./scripts/mise-exec.sh run hook:rust-fmt-staged -- {staged_files}` with the existing `**/*.rs` glob and `docs/research/infra/**` exclusion, `stage_fixed: true`.
5. Add a `name:` per job for clearer `lefthook run` output (metadata only; behavior unchanged).
6. Validation: `./node_modules/.bin/lefthook dump` to verify commands and templates; `./node_modules/.bin/lefthook run pre-commit` end-to-end with a staged TS/CSS/JSON change and a staged Rust change; verify an unstaged malformed file is not modified; verify React Doctor advisory behavior; verify `docs/research/infra/**` and `.agents/skills/**` exclusions; verify a path with spaces.

No scripts/mise-exec.sh changes, no mise.toml changes, no package.json changes — those are owned by sibling issues.

## Implementation plan

Status note: issue was in_progress with no branch/artifacts; treating as fresh run on branch bsm-9n1.4/lefthook-mise-adapters.

1. Rewrite lefthook.yml: all three pre-commit jobs route through ./scripts/mise-exec.sh run <adapter>. Adapter names as landed in bsm-9n1.3: hook:react-doctor-staged (wrapper preserved: mktemp capture, advisory hint, exit 0 always; no {staged_files} — react-doctor reads the git index), hook:ultracite-staged -- {staged_files} (existing JS/TS/JSON/CSS glob + exclusions, stage_fixed: true), hook:rust-fmt-staged -- {staged_files} (existing rs glob/exclusion, stage_fixed: true).
2. Verify: lefthook dump; lefthook run pre-commit with staged TS/CSS/JSON + Rust files; filename-with-spaces test; excluded-path test (docs/research/infra/**, .agents/skills/**); unstaged malformed file untouched; minimal-shell commit (mise not on PATH) after mise trust/install.
3. Fallback per issue: if staged-only Ultracite proves incompatible, document and revise contract.

title: Migrate Lefthook pre-commit to mise adapters
